name: Zaure Official Store
bio: This is our store — the one we check every morning before anything else. Featured products, hand-picked deals, and trusted services from across Nigeria, all in one place. If you're new to Zaure, start here. Everything you see has been chosen by us personally.

name: El
bio: El started with a simple idea: everyday things deserve to be made well. Shoe polish that actually protects. Shampoo that actually cleans. Products built for Nigerian leather, Nigerian hair, Nigerian weather. One name. Every detail.

name: Teema Kitchenwares
bio: We're a small Kaduna family business that takes kitchenware seriously. Glass jugs that don't crack, cookware that lasts, and the everyday tools that make cooking easier. Every item is one we'd use ourselves. Delivered carefully across Northern Nigeria — most of our customers come back a second time.
